Scene.JsonCapacityExceeded.zh: 画布内容超过工程正文 128 MiB 上限，请减少内容或拆分为多个工程。当前操作未应用。
Scene.JsonCapacityExceeded.en: Canvas content exceeds the 128 MiB document limit. Reduce content or split it into separate projects; the operation was not applied.

Scene.GroupDepthExceeded.zh: 组合层级达到 64 层上限。请取消部分编组后重试；当前操作未保存。
Scene.GroupDepthExceeded.en: Groups cannot exceed 64 levels. Ungroup some layers and try again; the operation was not applied.

Scene.PathCapacityExceeded.zh: 单条路径达到 200 万点上限，请分成多笔绘制。当前操作未应用。
Scene.PathCapacityExceeded.en: A path cannot exceed 2 million points. Draw separate strokes; the operation was not applied.

Images.ImportCapacityExceeded.zh: 图片超过导入预算：每批最多 32 个文件、单个 64 MiB、合计 128 MiB，解码后单张最多 1678 万像素、合计 6711 万像素。请缩小图片或分批导入。
Images.ImportCapacityExceeded.en: Image import budget exceeded: up to 32 files, 64 MiB each and 128 MiB total, 16.8 million decoded pixels per image and 67.1 million per batch. Resize the images or import smaller batches.

Project.ExternalChange.zh: 磁盘上的工程已被其他程序修改或移走，本次保存已停止。
Project.ExternalChange.en: The project on disk was changed or moved by another application. This save was stopped.

Project.ExternalCopyPreserved.zh: 检测到同时写入，外部版本已完整保留在：{0}
Project.ExternalCopyPreserved.en: A concurrent write was detected. Its complete version was preserved at: {0}

Project.SaveConflictChoice.zh: 可将当前画布另存为副本，或保留当前画布，稍后重新打开磁盘工程。
Project.SaveConflictChoice.en: Save the current canvas as a copy, or keep it and reopen the project from disk later.
